meta.notes: Schema-faithful seed fixture committed ahead of the live manual ritual (D-SMOKE-02). Each question's haystack carries the relevant sessions (in question.sessions) plus 2-3 noise sessions whose turns contain none of the answer's >=4-char tokens. Noise sessions are ordered FIRST so the unscoped pass (which flattens all sessions and takes top 5) gets pure-noise chunks -> recall=0 -> tpca falls into the in_tokens fallback branch (large). The scoped pass filters to question.sessions only -> turn content carries answer tokens -> recall=1.0 -> tpca = small in_tokens / 1.0. The expected_*_tpca values document the magnitude order; when the live re-derivation runs (scripts/derive_scoped_smoke.py) it replaces them with measured numbers and drops placeholder_until_live_rederivation. The dual-pass CI test asserts methodology (scoped < unscoped via mock backend) UNCONDITIONALLY; tolerance bounds against expected_*_tpca only enforce when placeholder_until_live_rederivation is false.
